question: Kumbh Mela 2021 organised at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haridwar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kumbh Mela 2021 was organized at Haridwar, Uttarakhand.**
 
• Kumbh Mela 2021 was held for only **30 days, from April 1 to 30** this year in view of the COVID-19 pandemic.<
